verdict.rationale: Qodo offers its own programmatic surfaces: an official MCP server and CLI that let agents retrieve and resolve review findings, retrieve rules, and review changes, plus configuration-as-code via .pr_agent.toml as an alternative to portal settings. However, no general public API is documented, all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404, and the portal is described as the recommended configuration path, so UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API or OpenAPI spec, programmatic coverage of portal features (governance history, Software Map, access management, integrations/setup wizard, rule management), and any statement or evidence of API–UI parity.
